instruction: Change the slide background to green and set the title font size to 36pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

Metric uses Euclidean color distance with tolerance=50 for background and 1pt tolerance for font size. 0.5 points each. llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts slide background color via python-pptx fill.fore_color.rgb and title font size via EMU-to-pt conversion (/12700), matching both instruction requirements.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_bg_color') without wrapping in rules layer.
Both instruction requirements (green background + 36pt title font) are verified with appropriate tolerances (Euclidean color distance <= 50, font size within 1pt).

Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring state freshness.
